$description: REPO-OWNED look tokens (NOT IN FIGMA). Every color comes from a locked Figma token, blended only with transparent; px literals only for geometry. Grammar: "{ref}" | "transparent" | "none" | "<n>px" | {"wash": ref} (radial, ref to transparent) | {"tint": ref, "alpha": 0-100} | {"highlight": ref, "alpha": 0-100} (inset 1px top line) | [layered shadow parts]. Keys: light + dark, or all. Emitted as --ds-<name> by scripts/build.mjs, validated by scripts/check-tokens.mjs.
